context:
Goal: a sender can tell a message arrived, on any device.
Problem (rule): no wake route works for every receiver, and the only device-neutral safety net, a sender's timed check-in, rests on a CLAUDE.md sentence you never signed off (09:36 CST).
Based on (ruling): your ruling of Nov 10, 09:33 CST: everything goes through the mailbox, with the cloud's direct session message (send_message) kept only as a doorbell; at 09:36 CST you said you are unsure of the doorbell.
Based on (measured): a cloud direct session message to a local computer was refused (elevated_session_untrusted_device), per the messaging design record's table of routes.
Departs from: the messaging design record on main, where the cloud keeps its direct session message and no check-in rule exists — adds one arrival rule for every device.
Meanwhile: the messaging session asked this in chat at 09:38 CST; your chat answer closes it. The draft that records the timed check-in question as answered waits for you.
home: the messaging design record (decision session-messages); step mailbox-all-messages

options.gain: Same on every device, and nothing is lost silently.
options.how: Every message goes through the mailbox, and a sender that waits for a reply sets one timed check-in; this also settles the open question of whether a sender may set one.
options.label: Mailbox plus one timed check-in per awaited reply (Recommended)
options.lose: An idle receiver reads only at its next turn, and this makes the check-in sentence your rule.

options.how: Every message goes through the mailbox, with no timer and no doorbell.
options.label: Mailbox only, no check-in
options.lose: A lost message goes unnoticed until someone looks, and the doorbell from your 09:33 CST ruling drops.

options.gain: An idle cloud session wakes at once, and your 09:33 CST ruling stands as given.
options.how: Every message goes through the mailbox, and a doorbell wakes the receiver where a route exists (cloud now, local later).
options.label: Mailbox plus a doorbell where one exists
options.lose: Behaviour differs by device, against your word that the device should not matter.

ref: page item 482; decision session-messages; PR #2544 (session-messages Q4 edit)
reply: Answered in chat, 09:39 CST Nov 10: "ok one check in is allowed, i just don't think it'll be hollistic enough, but it's allowed that is enough". A session that waits on a reply may set one timed check-in for it. You did not pick the doorbell; it stays open. Home: the messaging design record (decision session-messages), through its draft; step mailbox-all-messages.
title: How does a sender know a mailbox message arrived, on any device?
why: Recommended: a. It works the same on every device, and no message is lost silently.
